product_one_liner.value: Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS that connects business systems through no-code workflow automation and built-in API management for enterprise and mid-market IT, integration, operations, and engineering teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Koodisi is described as Ivoyant’s enterprise integration platform, with no-code workflow automation and built-in API management connecting business systems; its stated audience includes enterprise and mid-market IT/integration, operations, and engineering teams.

pricing_page.notes: Koodisi has a public pricing page that describes an Enterprise plan and explains that customers receive a quote, so public list prices are not required for the answer to be true.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The first-party capability statement’s past-performance list names PODS, UPS, and NAPA Auto Parts as clients/projects. | named_customers.0: The capability statement names PODS under past-performance highlights. | named_customers.1: The capability statement names UPS under past-performance highlights. | named_customers.2: The capability statement names NAPA Auto Parts under past-performance highlights.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile gives its company-size range as 201–500 employees. Some third-party headcount estimates differ, so the publicly stated size band is used with caution.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters address on the company profile is in Atlanta, Georgia; the city is Atlanta. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the headquarters address in Atlanta, Georgia, United States; the country is therefore the United States.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn identifies the Atlanta-based Ivoyant as founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The Ivoyant blog index is primarily broad modernization, marketing, and industry content; its developer-adjacent examples include a WakaTime productivity article and a personal-finance CRM tutorial, not two engineer-authored accounts of how Ivoyant’s product is built. It therefore does not meet the specified threshold for an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Koodisi has a public documentation portal with multiple sections and linked articles for building workflows, API management, activities, security, operations, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current iVoyant Greenhouse board explicitly lists an AI/ML Engineer opening.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (a configurable workflow integration; no default provider is named).
model_provider.notes: Koodisi documentation says its OpenAI activities call the OpenAI REST API and describes supplying an OpenAI API key; this establishes OpenAI as a configurable supported workflow provider, not as the product’s exclusive/default provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Koodisi’s first-party security page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 but says their certificates are still in the issuing pipeline and have not been issued; neither counts as a current certification under the criteria, and the page names no other listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Tracxn explicitly characterizes Ivoyant as unfunded and says it has not raised any rounds, so the requested stage is none. | funding_date: Tracxn states that Ivoyant is unfunded and has not raised any funding rounds; therefore its most recent funding date is represented as none.

raised_18mo.notes: Tracxn states Ivoyant has not raised any funding rounds and is unfunded, so it did not raise in the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists AI/ML Engineer, frontend, full-stack, test-engineering, and UX roles, and the company careers page lists design and platform-engineering roles; none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: Koodisi release notes date version 1.2.7 to October 2026 and mark it released to beta and production; they describe the new ability to build, deploy, and test workflows from Koodisi AI chat, a major feature within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small current team page lists its leadership and shows no new C-level or VP appointment; a profile says COO Sonya Beredimas joined Ivoyant in 2018, before the window. No departure announcement or in-window executive change was found, so the answer is false, with some uncertainty because the roster does not date every person’s role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: An iVoyant sales-development job listing names Apollo as a prospecting tool and HubSpot as a CRM example; these are the CRM/sales-system signals visible in the posting. | crm_stack_signal.0: The sales-development posting explicitly names Apollo as a prospecting-tool example. | crm_stack_signal.1: The sales-development posting explicitly names HubSpot as a CRM example.
